chapter.verse: Tu-in Paisan Pawi ma-in Jesu in hih leitung pan Pa' kiangah a zuat ding hunlenai tung ta ahihlam a theih ciangin leitunga om ama' mite it ahih manin a tawp dongin amaute it hi.
Nitak annek sungin dawimangpa in Simon' tapa Judas Iscariot ii lungsim sungah Jesu lehhek ding geelna koih khinzo hi.
Jesu in Pa in na khempeuh ama' tungah ap khin ahihna thu leh amah pen Pasian' kiangpan hong pai-in Pasian' kiangah ciahkik ding ahihna thu thei ahih manin
annekna pan dingto hi. A puan tungnungte suahin mainul khat la a, a kawng ah vet hi.
Tua ciangin kuangkum sung khat ah tui sung a, nungzuite' khe sil kipanin a kawnga a mainul vet tawh a khete uh nul hi.
Simon Peter' kiangah a tun ciangin Peter in, “Topa aw, ka khe sil ding na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Tu laitak ka sep thu na tel loh hangin tu nungah na tel ding hi,” ci hi.
Peter in, “Cikmah ciangin ka khe na sil ngeikei ding hi,” a cih ciangin Jesu in, “Na khe ka sil kei ding leh kei tawh kizopna na nei kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Simon Peter in, “Topa, ka khe bek hilo-in ka khut leh ka lu zong sil in,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “A kipumsil khinsa mite siangtho ahih manin a khe lobuang sil kul lo hi. Note na siangtho uh a, ahi zongin na vekpi-un a siang kim na hikei uh hi,” ci hi.
A hang pen amah a lehlek dingpa thei khin ahih man hi; tua hangin, “Na vekpi-un a siang kim na hikei uh hi,” a ci ahi hi.
A khete uh a sil khit, a puan tungnungte a silhkik khit, ama' tutna mun a tunkik khit ciangin Jesu in hih bangin gen hi: “Note' tunga kong sep thu na tel uh hiam?
Kei pen Topa leh Syapa nong ci uh a, hi ka hih manin na maan uh hi.
Tua hi a, note' Topa leh Syapa ahi keimah in na khe uh hong silsak ka hihleh note zong khatlekhat khe na kisilsak ding uh kilawm hi.
A hang pen note' tunga kong hih bangin note in zong na hih nadingun etteh lim khat kong pia khinzo hi.
Maantak diktak kong cihin ah sila khat a topa sangin lianzaw lo a, kamtaipa zong amah a sawlpa sangin lianzaw lo hi.
Hih thute thei na hih uhleh tua bangin sem hileh uhcin thuphangah na hi uh hi.
Na vekun hong ci ka hikei hi; ka tenkhiatsa mite ka thei hi. Ahih hangin, ‘Ka anlum a ne mipa in a khetul tawh hong tuan hi,’ a cihna Pasian' Laibu tangtung ding hi.
Hih thu a pian hun ciangin kei amah ka hihlam na up theih nadingun hih thu a pian ma, tu-in note hong gen ka hi hi.
Maantak diktak kong cihin ah ka sawl mipa a sang peuhmah kei hong sang hi a, kei hong sang peuhmah kei hong sawlpa a sang ahi hi.”
Hih thute a gen khit ciangin Jesu a sungtawng pan lunggim mahmah ahih manin, “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah note lakah khat in kei hong lehhek ding hi,” ci-in pulak hi.
Kua a ci nuam cih lungbuai-in nungzuite khatlekhat ki-en uh hi.
A nungzuite lakah Jesu' itdeuhpa pen Jesu' ang lamah tu ahih manin
Simon Peter in Jesu' gennop kua hiding cih a dong dingin tua nungzuipa mit-hek pia hi.
Jesu' awm tunga kingam tua nungzuipa in zong, “Topa aw, kua ahi hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Jesu in, “Hih ka anlum bakno ka diah khit teh ka piak dingpa pen ahi hi,” a cih khit ciangin anlum bakno diahin Simon Iscariot' tapa Judas pia hi.
Judas zong anlum bakno a san khit ciangin a sungah Satan lut hi. Jesu in, “Na hih ding peuh manlangin hih in,” ci hi.
Bang hangin Judas' tungah hih bangin gen cih, ankuang uum-a a tute kuamah in thei lo uh hi.
Judas sumbawm a len ahih manin Jesu in, “Pawi' ading i kisap teng va lei in,” a ci hiding, ahihkeileh mizawngte' tungah bang khatpeuh piak ding a sawl hiding, ci-in ngaihsun uh hi.
Tua hi a, Judas zong anlum bakno a san khit ciangin pusuak pah hi. A hun pen zan ahi hi.
Judas a pusuah khit ciangin Jesu in hih bangin gen hi: “Tu-in Mihing' Tapa kipahtawi a, Pasian zong ama' sungah kipahtawi hi.
Ama' hangin Pasian in minpha ngah ahihleh Pasian in zong Mihing' Tapa minpha pia ding a, thakhat thu-in pia pah ding hi.

Tanote aw, note tawh tawmvei sung bek kong om lai ding hi. Kei nong zong ding uh a, Jew makaite' kiangah, ‘Ka paina mun nong pai theikei ding uh hi,’ ka cihdan lian mahin tu-in zong note' kiangah kong ci hi.
Thupiakna thak khat kong nei hi: Note khatlekhat ki-it un. Note kong it mah bangin note zong khatlekhat a ki-it dingte na hi uh hi.
Note khatlekhat na ki-it uhleh mite in tua tungtawnin ka nungzuite na hihlam uh hong thei ding uh hi.”
Simon Peter in, “Topa aw, nang koi ah pai ding na hi hiam?” ci hi. Jesu in, “Ka paina mun ah tu-in nong zui thei kei ding uh a, ahi zongin tu nungah nong zui ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Peter in, “Topa aw, bang hangin tu-in hong zui theilo ding ka hi hiam? Nang' adingin ka nuntakna ka pia ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Kei' adingin na nuntakna hong pia ding na hi hiam? Maantak diktak kong cihin ah ak khuan ma-in thumvei nong nial ding hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
